title: The must-know endings list

D0.outcome: States, for each position on the curated must-know list, whether it is a win or draw and the key idea.

D1.outcome: Given a position from the list, names the winning or drawing method and the move.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled sets mixing list positions and failing look-alikes, classifies each correctly.

D3.outcome: Plays each list position against the tablebase-backed opponent from either side.

misconceptions: Memorise the list instead of the principle.
conditions: Each theoretical position runs principle, then verified family, then failing look-alike, then play against a tablebase-backed opponent.
contrasts: A list position replaced by a near-identical position with a different result.
Recalling the position without the principle.
Positions from the list that need more than 7 pieces.
